method: Each original desktop-closed, desktop-open, mobile-closed, mobile-open PNG and marketing WebP was separately inspected via vision_analyze; no comparison boards used. Parent verdicts consulted after image inspection.
scope: Static visual review only; no fresh animation, collision, source parity, archive verification or final user approval.
shared_findings: All supplied open/closed desktop/mobile views contain the complete object without obvious viewport cropping or overlapping controls.

Open views reveal empty hollow interiors and rear brass-colored hinge hardware. Visible rear clearance can make lids appear suspended; these stills do not prove detached hinges or collision-free motion.
Mobile supporting text is small. This is a readability caveat, not a measured accessibility failure.
No unambiguous critical rendering failure or severe mesh intersection was identified in these views. Material and illustration differences remain artistic decisions, not authorization to edit.

entries.desktop_closed: Gray coursed masonry, turquoise canal inset, pale platform bases and miniature stacked architecture are legible; strong seam and pale irregular feet draw attention.
entries.desktop_open: Empty gray cavity and plain lid underside visible, with rear hinges and released clasp; no conspicuous intersection or crop.
entries.mobile_closed: Canal and architecture identity survives at phone size; coarse masonry and bright feet are more prominent than fine basalt texture.
entries.mobile_open: Full lid and feet fit; hollow interior reads clearly though dark lower surfaces lose detail.
entries.marketing_comparison: Same principal chest, canal/platform arrangement and hardware language. Marketing has more tactile grain, softened pale bases and fuzzy-looking feet; runtime is smoother, harder-edged and more regular. Water remains an opaque turquoise insert rather than convincing tidal water.
entries.decision: Retain needs-decision for stylization/material fidelity; no demonstrated need for structural regeneration.

entries.desktop_closed: Yellow-ochre dune chest, pale playa detail and brass fittings are coherent; pronounced dark seam reads partly open even in the closed pose.
entries.desktop_open: Dark brown hollow cavity, raised rim and two hinges visible. Rear gap warrants a contact caveat, not a confirmed detached-lid diagnosis.
entries.mobile_closed: Dune silhouette and orange/gold identity readable; complete box contained without overlap.
entries.mobile_open: Full open silhouette contained; cavity visible but bottom largely occluded by perspective.
entries.marketing_comparison: Marketing is substantially paler peach with elongated curled/warped-looking ridges and a conspicuous pale patch; runtime presents compact ochre dunes. Color and terrain reading differ enough to warrant a direction decision, rather than assuming exact equivalence.
entries.decision: Retain visual decision hold AND Namibia complete-source-archive inventory hold. Screenshot review cannot clear the archive gate.

entries.desktop_closed: Blue-gray chest and stark white caldera enclosing blue lake are legible; caldera looks simplified and lake flat.
entries.desktop_open: Empty blue-gray cavity and lighter floor visible. Raised lid has apparent rear separation; precise hinge seating cannot be established.
entries.mobile_closed: White caldera remains prominent but looks snow/plaster-like rather than detailed volcanic terrain. Small lake loses relief at normal scale.
entries.mobile_open: Full open silhouette and empty cavity visible; rear brass hinges readable with no major obvious intersection.
entries.marketing_comparison: Both retain white crater/blue lake and slate-blue box. Marketing shows stronger vertical crater ridging and finer fabric-like body grain; runtime is smoother and more patterned. Apparent caldera/lake size differences are not dimensional proof because camera and framing differ.
entries.decision: Retain needs-decision for terrain and finish fidelity; no proven functional defect.

entries.desktop_closed: Jade-green streaked chest, pale banks and water channel with two visible tree forms; sparse flat foliage and blurred/repeated body texture.
entries.desktop_open: Empty jade-patterned interior and brass rim visible; rear lid connection looks separated in projection but no major collision is evident.
entries.mobile_closed: Tree/bank motif remains readable; streaky body texture dominates fine detail and dark feet merge into background.
entries.mobile_open: Full open assembly fits. Cavity remains visible; hinge contact detail is insufficient to certify attachment.
entries.marketing_comparison: Marketing clearly presents three trees, more glossy marbling and gold-toned irregular bank panels around a winding turquoise channel. Closed runtime views show two visible tree forms, sparser canopy and flatter pale banks. This is a visible presentation mismatch, not proof of the underlying mesh count or a missing mesh.
entries.decision: Strongly retain needs-decision; explicitly preserve the three-versus-two visible-tree inconsistency and material/bank differences without calling it a mechanical bug.

entries.desktop_closed: Brown wood-like chest, green rim and tree-lined wetland miniature retain the concept. Small canopy forms are stylized rather than detailed vegetation.
entries.desktop_open: Empty brown cavity and green rim; two rear hinges and released upper tab visible without major intersections.
entries.mobile_closed: Wetland silhouette, front latch and side ring remain clear; foliage and shoreline detail compress at phone scale.
entries.mobile_open: Hollow interior and raised lid fit entirely; rear contact overlap cannot be resolved conclusively from the still.
entries.marketing_comparison: Marketing uses fuller rounded canopy, more sculpted pond edge and textured leather-like brown panels. Runtime has more wood-like grain and simplified/segmented canopy and shoreline. Identity is retained but material and terrain polish are not equivalent.
entries.decision: Retain needs-decision for material/landscape direction, not for a demonstrated runtime break.

entries.desktop_closed: Three crenellated towers on pale rocky bases, blue seam and brass hardware are clearly retained. Bright stone loses surface definition.
entries.desktop_open: Empty pale cavity, blue rim and plain lid underside visible; complete object fits with no obvious severe intersection.
entries.mobile_closed: All three towers remain readable; body and rock detail are simplified at phone scale. No crop or UI overlap.
entries.mobile_open: Full raised lid, hinges and cavity are visible; hinge/rim contact needs other views for a physical claim.
entries.marketing_comparison: Close identity match: three unequal-height towers, faceted rocks, pale body, blue seam and principal hardware persist. Marketing has more articulated rock edges and surface shading; runtime is brighter and more uniform. This is a low-severity polish discrepancy, not a demonstrated mechanical correction need.
entries.decision: Parent hold is defensible as a conservative user art decision, not a technical fail. Preserve it; no final approval or automatic regeneration.
